policy_notes: One identifiable physical front per row; own frontal rim included, broad roof/rack/gripper excluded.

Monitor depictions are background under the physical-scene task; no new depiction class is introduced.
Source IDs are immutable. Added row IDs remain distinct even when a deletion keeps the numeric row count unchanged.
All320 frames are mined development material. Filename spacing and distinct hashes do not prove independent captures.
The three complete images are annotation candidates only. A controlled experiment must define their training assignment; no independent test claim.
R43 preserves every R42 identity, hold and whole-image gate. Historical R42 prediction figures retain their original reference labels; they are not R43 scores.

New ownership uncertainty can revoke a prior whole-image export gate. Illustrative traced outlines are not training segmentation masks.
